name: Francesco Colosimo
bioAdditions: Francesco Filippo was baptized on 24 September 1719, son of Antonino Colosimo and Antonia Mendicino (S1). He married Giulia Putero on 26 February 1740 (S2). His mother, Antonia Mendicino, is new to the tree.
